approach.method_basis: The reference being measured is the lineage's current best algorithm: a graph genetic algorithm whose oracle calls are chosen by Gaussian-process Thompson sampling, with one stall reflex on top. In every announced round it breeds a fresh field of 160 molecules from a 64-member elite, drawing breeding parents mostly from the top score quantiles and building each child either by joining connected fragments of two parents, sometimes with one further edit, or by a short chain of atom, bond and ring edits. It rejects duplicates and any child that would introduce a sulfur environment its scored parents do not already carry, and it admits only candidates whose identity survives a parse-and-serialize round trip. A Gaussian process trained solely on the molecules scored so far in that same run, over count-based Morgan fingerprints with a Tanimoto-type similarity, predicts the whole fresh field; ten correlated posterior samples then each buy their own best still-available candidate, and those ten molecules are scored. The reflex is what earlier Children added: after three consecutive rounds with no new best score, only the forty candidates with the highest predicted mean stay eligible to be bought, until a round improves again. Two independent random streams drive a run - one makes every breeding decision, the other draws only the correlated posterior samples the buyers use - and the reflex itself consumes no randomness. The reflex is a rule inside the buying step, not the breeding step: it changes the menu the ten samples may choose from. On the recorded runs it governed 88 of 435 rounds across 13 of the 15 runs, and two runs never stalled at all.
approach.novelty: This node adds no search behaviour. It is the placebo the stall reflex has never had in the stream where the reflex itself acts. In each round in which the eligibility restriction is active, and in no other round, it draws one block of correlated-sample noise of exactly the shape the buyers consume, from exactly their own generator, immediately before they consume theirs, and throws it away. Nothing reads it: the predicted means, the fitted correlations, the eligible forty, the purchase rule, the counter, the pool and every breeding decision stay as they are, and the buyers still draw exactly one block of their own. All that changes is which words of their stream the buyers get, and only from the first stalled round of each run onward. The two placebos this Anchor already has both re-draw in the breeding stream, one in every round and one only in stalled rounds, so they price how much luck lives in which molecules get built; the two allocator-stream placebos in the lineage were drawn on the earlier algorithm that had no reflex at all, so they price a different host and every round of it. This round's other two references re-draw the buyers' stream in every round, ungated, which charges luck over all 435 rounds and sacrifices the two unusually high results this Parent's panel leans on. Confining the re-draw to the stalled rounds keeps the two never-stalling runs reproduced number for number, keeps every run's pre-stall prefix identical, and keeps the fresh field of the very first stalled round identical to the Anchor's - so what the panel then moves by is the departure of the buyers' luck inside, and only inside, the rounds the reflex governs. Every other sibling changed a rule - a doubled field, a session-calibrated spread, an ensemble-disagreement spread, greedy allocation, holding or releasing the restriction - or removed a dormant branch and reproduced the Parent exactly, so none of them can supply this scale.

observed_bottleneck: The Parent is the formal L01 Anchor n-61b9b3bfb40d, and what limits it is not an algorithmic behaviour but a measurement gap in the channel where its own retained element acts. The Anchor's single positive result is +0.010577 against its mask-free Parent n-1744a1494180 (panel 0.607030; seed macros 0.649701/0.585234/0.586156; paired seed deltas +0.006603/+0.022061/+0.003067), and the element that earns it - the stall-conditioned top-forty posterior-mean eligibility restriction, K=3 consecutive non-improving announced batches, M=40 of the unchanged 160-member fresh pool - is a rule about which pooled candidates the allocation may buy at all. It acts entirely inside the allocator, on the sequentially masked correlated-draw purchase rule, and it consumes no randomness of its own. In the frozen catalog v-82750d565d68c5980ec7dbef that element carries needs_evidence true with an evidence list of length zero, one of eleven contribution gaps standing on this Anchor. Every scale its margin has ever been read against is mismatched to it in channel, exposure class or host. (i) Both law-free references on this host depart through the breeding generator: n-515ab49db6e0 discards one random() draw in every announced batch (panel -0.020452, band [-0.055482, +0.014579], half-width 0.035031) and n-7e8300237702 discards one only in the 84 batches its own restriction governed (panel -0.021233, band [-0.044783, +0.002316], half-width 0.023549). That 0.023549 is the number round 47 used to call the element uncalibrated, and the removable-mechanism reading recorded in h-8dd12ac6bcdf5e61 rests on it - but it prices departure in the stream that breeds candidates, not in the stream that buys them. (ii) The only allocator-stream realizations on this lineage are hosted on the mask-free Parent: n-47993ce5d053 (-0.001735) and n-843b25e73dee (+0.007747), whose registered two-point rule gives W 0.009482 and band [-0.003735, +0.009747]. They are a different host, and their span straddles +0.010577 exactly. (iii) The component's own isolated delta can no longer be re-measured on this host: n-c4c934fd6a68 retains the whole restriction code and is byte-identical to the mask-free removal n-f04cec6ab705 in all fifteen trajectory files, removing the mask from the Anchor code reproduces n-1744a1494180 exactly, and n-cf8d309c06de reproduces the Anchor record for record at paired delta exactly 0.000000, so +0.010577 is fixed and the entire open quantity is the width of the scale it must clear. Its own exposure axis is non-positive in both directions (n-c7eb0cb7da3b -0.007929 holding the regime, n-5911390da209 -0.000562 releasing it, and the widened-field arm n-41ba6b01b5a5 refuted at -0.030756), two further mask-era arms n-f84de4030e74 and n-25b9a57765d8 add nothing to the element's own evidence list, and h-2fa4b3d0e8726724 states plainly that a trigger-matched reference or a mask-confined variant is the only measurement that can price it. So the limiting behaviour is this: on its own host, in its own channel and in its own exposure class, this Anchor has no departure scale at all.
hypothesis: Trigger-matched, channel-matched law-free path divergence in the allocator stream of the stall-masked Anchor. No law, probability, threshold, rule or constant changes anywhere, and no mechanism is added, removed or modified. Inside FingerprintPosterior.select, after the inherited predictive distribution and the inherited pool_posterior Cholesky factorization have been computed and immediately before the inherited allocation draws its own standard-normal array, draw exactly one extra standard-normal array of the inherited allocation shape (suggestion batch size by pool size, 10 by 160) from that selector's own seeded torch generator - the generator that draws nothing else in the program - and discard it, if and only if the restrict_top_mean argument of that same call is not None. That argument is the inherited per-batch eligibility-restriction object itself: the same value the mask below reads to build the eligible set, computed by the inherited K=3 counter in Evolution.suggest and logged in that batch's stall_regime_state. The gate is therefore the restriction's own predicate, so the discard cannot fire in a batch whose eligible set is unrestricted and cannot fail to fire in one whose eligible set is restricted. Outside the restricted regime nothing extra is consumed at all. Because the selector's generator is consumed only by that one inherited draw, the discard is exactly a one-block offset of the inherited allocator stream: from each session's first restricted batch onward the ten correlated sample rows are different pseudo-random words, so different eligible candidates win the ten sequentially masked purchases, and the realized path departs from the Anchor inside the restricted regime only. Everything that decides anything stays exactly as inherited: the accepted-only chronological count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto posterior with its 0.05 observation-noise SD, adaptive mean and population-SD normalization, its full cross-candidate covariance, its float64 Cholesky jitter ladder and its predictive mean and marginal dispersion; the eligibility rule with K=3, M=40 of the unchanged 160-member pool, the (-posterior mean, pool index) ordering, the per-pick mask update, the first-index tie rule, the bounded valid fallback and restoration on the first improving batch; the single array of the inherited shape the allocation draws for itself and its consumption order; the sulfur gate, canonical identity admission, both duplicate scopes, greedy-64 retention, quantile breeding with its shared random.Random(seed) stream, the continuation law, the seven operator families at unchanged weights and connected-fragment crossover at 0.45 with its 0.35 finishing edit. No decision, receipt-driven or otherwise, reads a discarded value. The claim is a measurement, not a gain: the complete matched fifteen-cell panel delta against the Anchor is what law-free allocator-stream departure costs when it is confined to the batches the mask governs, with the Anchor's other 347 announced batches and both of its never-stalling deco_hop sessions untouched by construction.

finding_summary.headline: Channel-matched gated placebo ran exactly; panel -0.0179, half-width 0.0249, and the Anchor's whole +0.0106 sits in the two cells it broke
finding_summary.insights:
The scale the campaign went looking for now exists in the right channel, and it does not rescue the restriction. Matching the channel was supposed to be what made the earlier number too wide: the gated breeding-channel half-width was 0.023549, and the hope was that perturbing the stream the restriction itself acts in would give something near the 0.009482 the mask-free Parent showed. It gave 0.024878 - slightly wider than the breeding-channel figure, two and a half times the margin it has to price. So channel mismatch was never the reason the scale was wide, and the two remaining explanations the campaign had for calling the element uncalibrated have collapsed into one.

That one reason is now measured precisely, and it is the finding worth carrying forward. The Anchor's entire +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent is two cells: sitagliptin_mpo seed 0 (+0.071580) and seed 1 (+0.144470), with the other thirteen cells averaging -0.004415. This run, which changes no rule and only reorders the words one generator reads inside about one round in five, moved those same two cells by -0.093646 and -0.171941 - each larger than the gain it carries - while the other thirteen cells moved by an average of -0.000252 and never by more than 0.0221. The breeding-channel reference moved the identical pair by -0.102470 and -0.157500. Two placebos in two different streams, with two different gates, hit the same two cells by the same order of magnitude and leave the rest of the panel alone. The Anchor's margin is therefore not merely unseparated from path luck; it is located exactly where this method's endpoint is least reproducible, and no reading that leans on those two cells can price any mechanism at this budget. The useful corollary for planning is cheap to state: on this Anchor, a thirteen-cell or two-cell reading is a statement about sitagliptin_mpo, not about an algorithm, and a difference below roughly 0.025 on the fifteen-cell panel is not readable as a rule effect in this exposure class at all.

Reported as an observation and not as this node's claim, median_2 says the same thing from the other side. All three of its seeds diverged early (records 41, 181 and 81), and the top-25 Murcko scaffold sets of this run and the Anchor share nothing on any seed - not one scaffold, not one molecule - yet the three cells land within 0.0162 of the Anchor's, two of them above. The objective's own landscape explains it: the best of 870 proposals is 0.228969 against a 900-record median of 0.187508, 35 distinct scaffolds share the top 50, and single-atom ring relabellings score within 0.009 of the leader. sitagliptin_mpo seed 2 makes the point sharply: it diverged at record 171 and still finished on exactly 0.620122, from a different molecule. So median_2 is nearly blind as a discriminator of allocation rules at 300 calls - its cells will agree whatever the search does - while sitagliptin_mpo is where all the variance lives. A future measurement on this host should expect to learn almost nothing from median_2 and should be designed around sitagliptin_mpo's instability rather than averaging over it.

On the method itself, two measured limitations, both inherited rather than introduced here. First, the surrogate ranks worst exactly where the restriction makes it decisive: the within-batch agreement between predicted and realized scores is 0.377 across the 89 restricted batches against 0.560 across the 346 unrestricted ones (Anchor 0.392 against 0.547), so the stall reflex responds to a stall by narrowing all ten purchases onto the part of the posterior ordering that is least trustworthy in that regime - and the narrowing is not inert, since 76 of 89 restricted batches buy a different batch than a passive full-mask replay of the same drawn rows would. The class of change that could remove this is a different ranking model (one fitted to order candidates rather than to regress their scores, or one that prices its own disagreement) or a stall response that changes where proposals come from instead of narrowing allocation over the same surrogate; a different K or M cannot fix a ranking that is wrong in the regime it governs. Second, late search is local refinement of one inherited skeleton: distinct Murcko scaffolds per 100 proposals fall from 54.2 in the first hundred to 36.0 in the last hundred, and a quarter of each session's final hundred proposals sit on the final best molecule's own scaffold (the Anchor: 55.0 to 36.7, and 26.7 per cent). The molecular report finds the same thing chemically - ring N-S and N-N bonds produced by relabelling one ring atom, scoring within 0.009 of the leader - which points at a proposal operator with skeleton-level moves (ring replacement, valence-aware ring vocabulary, fragment-level recombination late in the budget) rather than any reweighting of the seven existing edits. Neither diagnosis is about this node, which reproduces the Anchor's diversity profile exactly as a law-free offset should.

What stays open. This is one dependent realization: it bounds a departure, estimates nothing, and supports no significance statement in either direction. Whether the eligibility restriction contributes anything on this host is still unanswered, and the catalog's empty evidence list for it is unchanged by this node. The two ungated allocator-channel positions of this same round are still in flight, so the confined-versus-whole-run comparison within this channel cannot yet be made. And the measurement that could still separate the restriction from regime-confined luck is the one the campaign already named: a mask-confined variant on the Anchor's own path, or any design that does not have to read its answer out of sitagliptin_mpo seeds 0 and 1.
finding_summary.results:
The construction did exactly what it declared, on the real CUDA receipts. One discard receipt was written in every one of the 435 announced batches; a standard-normal block of the allocation shape was actually drawn and thrown away in exactly the 89 batches whose own stall counter had the restriction active, and never in the other 346. The two sessions that never stall, deco_hop seeds 0 and 2, reproduced the Anchor molecule for molecule and score for score across all 300 records and all 29 batches, finishing at 0.8561477 and 0.6442340 exactly; every other session reproduced the Anchor event for event up to its own first restricted batch (75,856 inherited log events, 2,163 of 4,500 trajectory records). The one-block offset is now verified on the real hardware and not just in the pre-run check: at each session's first restricted batch the discarded block is the Anchor's own active block to all 1,600 values in 13 of 13 exposed sessions, the run's own block there differs in all 1,600 values, and it is the block the Anchor only reaches one batch later. At that batch the bred pool of 160, the fit, the predicted means and the eligible forty are the Anchor's receipts hash for hash, and only the purchases move: 7 to 10 of the ten buys differ, all still inside the eligible forty. Every inherited law audited clean on both sides, including the stall counter recount in 435 of 435 batches, the first-index-argmax purchase rule at all 4,350 positions, and the operator, crossover and finishing frequencies within four standard errors of their declared values.

The panel came in at 0.589106 against the Anchor's 0.607030, a paired fifteen-cell mean of -0.017924, about nine times the 0.002 scale the campaign calls meaningful. No seed moved up: the seed macros fell by 0.020631, 0.029333 and 0.003810, so the across-seed spread is 0.0106 and seed 0 is the second largest loss rather than a gain; the orientation figures circulating with this ticket (a positive seed 0 and a spread near 0.037) do not reproduce from the receipts. Seven of fifteen cells rose, five fell and three are identical. The registered reading rule gives a spread of 0.048176 over the fifteen cells, so the half-width is 2*s/sqrt(15) = 0.024878 (the 0.009482 two-point floor never binds) and the gated allocator-channel band is [-0.042803, +0.006954]. The Anchor's +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent therefore sits above the band's upper edge by 0.003623 under the position clause, while the band's own half-width is 2.35 times that gain, which the same rule's width clause classes as leaving the restriction uncalibrated. The median_2 band is [-0.014090, +0.007792] (R -0.003149, half-width 0.010941 from its three cells 0.228969/0.221824/0.226250). Of the four protected task means, deco_hop, drd2_docking and zaleplon_mpo stay within margin and sitagliptin_mpo falls 0.088529, beyond its 0.02 margin. In-regime behaviour is otherwise the Anchor's: zero of 890 restricted purchases outside the eligible forty, mean predicted rank 10.96 against 11.70, increment mass 0.483876 against 0.547037, 25 of 89 restricted batches breaking the stall against 25 of 88, and unchanged diversity (115.5 distinct scaffolds per session against 117.5, mean pairwise similarity 0.312 against 0.311).

molecular.headline: A path-reshuffled twin of its Anchor: two sessions identical molecule for molecule, elsewhere the same scaffold class with a different exotic halogen motif
molecular.overall_character: This node is a law-free path divergence on code Parent n-61b9b3bfb40d, not a chemical intervention, and the molecules read exactly that way. Across 4,350 optimizer proposals (five objectives x three seeds x 290, plus ten shared pool records per session) every SMILES parses - zero structural failures - and the bulk envelope is the Anchor's to within noise: 24.3-31.8 mean heavy atoms against the Anchor's 24.5-31.5, 2.92-4.38 rings against 3.04-4.76, fsp3 0.17-0.37 against 0.17-0.38, mean QED 0.31-0.67 against 0.31-0.65. The digest counters agree that ring and aromatic density is real rather than a string artefact: ring_closure_rate 0.9724-0.9805 and aromatic_atom_rate 0.9586-0.9759 on all five objectives, with charged_rate 0.0 and stereocentre_rate 0.0 everywhere. So the rules determine the entire physical envelope - size, flatness, ring count, neutrality, achirality - and the path determines only which exotic group the exploitation phase latches onto. Two sessions (deco_hop seeds 0 and 2) are identical to the Anchor in all 300 records, SMILES and score alike, as registered; deco_hop seed 0 ends at 0.8561477222467935 on both sides and seed 2 at 0.6442339647723496. In the thirteen sessions that diverge, the first mismatch falls between evaluation 41 and evaluation 231, and the Murcko scaffold class survives the divergence even though the molecules do not: zaleplon_mpo seed 1, drd2_docking seed 0 and sitagliptin_mpo seed 2 each end on exactly the Anchor's best-molecule scaffold, and sitagliptin_mpo seed 2 ends on the identical score 0.620122 from a path that split at evaluation 171. Where the reshuffle mattered chemically it swapped one implausible motif for another: sitagliptin_mpo seed 1 carries 183 O-halogen (hypohalite) proposals against the Anchor's 7, zaleplon_mpo seed 0 carries 190 N-halogen proposals against the Anchor's 12. The standing liabilities are unchanged from the Anchor: 590 of 870 zaleplon_mpo and 174 of 870 sitagliptin_mpo proposals contain an N-F, N-Cl or N-Br bond, 193 of 870 sitagliptin_mpo proposals an O-halogen, exactly one molecule in 4,350 contains a CF3, 2,373 of 4,350 carry an unassigned stereocentre, and 103 proposals of six or fewer heavy atoms still reach the oracle as late as evaluation 293.

per_task.generated_character: Indole-2-carboxamides and their N-halogenated analogues. Mean 24.3 heavy atoms, 2.92 rings of which 2.71 aromatic, fsp3 0.20, QED 0.61, no invalid SMILES; digest counters aromatic_atom_rate 0.9759, ring_closure_rate 0.9782, halogen_rate 0.9586, charged_rate 0.0, stereocentre_rate 0.0, mean SMILES length 42.9. The run visits 177 Murcko scaffolds over 900 records but its top 50 hold only 5, and 44 of those 50 are one indole-2-carboxanilide or -2-carboxamidopyridine. All twelve digest best molecules are a single 4-ethyl-7-methoxy(or methyl) indole-2-carboxamide to pyridin-2-yl, differing only in which halogen sits on the indole nitrogen and whether the amide nitrogen is NH or N-Cl; they are all from seed 1. The divergence did not lose the Anchor's own leader - the Anchor's seed-1 best molecule CCc1c(OC)cc2c(c1C)c(Br)c(C(=O)Nc1ccccn1)n2F is present in this node's seed-1 set and in the digest best list at 0.438799 - it simply found the doubly halogenated version first. Seed 2's final six proposals are the same 1H-indole-2-carboxamide carrying N(F) or N(Br) amides.
liabilities: the panel's best molecule is an N-chloroamide on an N-fluoroindole, a halogenating reagent rather than isolable drug matter
N-halogen bonds in 590 of 870 proposals, 188 more than the Anchor's 402 on the same objective, and 190 of seed 0's 290 against the Anchor's 12
an N-S bond grafted onto the indole nitrogen in CCc1c(OC)cc2c(c1C)c(Cl)c(C(=O)Nc1ccccn1)n2SCl at 0.417001
a terminal C=N imine left dangling on the last proposal of seed 2, Cc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)N(F)c3cccc(O)c3)cc2c(C)c1C=N at 0.423210
18 proposals of six or fewer heavy atoms, arriving as late as evaluation 262
missing_features: no CF3, OCF3 or any polyhalogenated carbon in the 870 proposals, although 846 of 900 records carry a halogen somewhere
no nitrile: 5 of 900 records contain C#N and none of them reaches the top 50
no pyrazolo- or imidazo-fused 5,6-bicyclic nitrogen heteroaromatic; the aromatic bicycle is an indole or azaindole in all 50 of the top 50
no sulfonamide and no carboxylic acid at all (0 of 870 each), so no acidic or strongly polar handle is ever offered on this series

transferable_gaps.evidence: Exactly one of 4,350 proposals contains a CF3 group, while the digest halogen_rate is 0.81-0.98 on four of the five objective sets. Against that, 590 of 870 proposals in one set and 174 of 870 in another carry an N-F, N-Cl or N-Br bond, and 193 of 870 in one set carry an O-halogen. The single highest-scoring molecule of one set, CCc1c(C)cc2c(cc(C(=O)N(Cl)c3ccccn3)n2F)c1OC, has a halogen on both of its nitrogens and none on carbon, and 99 of that set's top 100 carry an N-halogen bond against 36 of its bottom 100 - the gradient is being climbed through a bond class no chemist would isolate.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator cannot build a polyhalogenated carbon substituent, and it halogenates nitrogen and oxygen as readily as carbon.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A halogenation operator should pick carbon attachment points only, and should be able to place two or three halogens on the same carbon in a single edit, so that mass, lipophilicity and halogen-count pressure are satisfied by a group that exists. Heteroatom-halogen bonds should be unreachable by construction rather than merely unrewarded, since several objectives score them well.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The digest stereocentre_rate is 0.0 on all five objective sets, so not one SMILES in 4,350 carries a defined configuration, yet 2,373 of those 4,350 contain at least one unassigned stereocentre - 837 of 870 in a single set, where all 100 of the top 100 are amines on a saturated ring whose geometry is left open (CSc1cc(Br)c(C)c(CCN2CCCCNC(C)(c3cccc(Cl)c3)C2)c1 scores 0.999995 as an undefined mixture). Fused polycyclic leaders have two or three such centres at once, as in CCCc1ccc(OCC)c(N2C(=O)CN3c4ccccc4C4=C(C2=O)C3CCN4C)c1.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator creates sp3 stereocentres constantly and never assigns a configuration to any of them.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The proposal operators need a stereocentre-assignment edit: when an edit creates a tetrahedral centre it should emit a specified configuration, and enumerating the configurations of an otherwise fixed molecule should be an available move. Without it the generator cannot distinguish the two halves of any three-dimensional reward surface, and every leader it reports is a mixture rather than a compound.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The digest charged_rate is 0.0 on all five objective sets. Sulfonamide appears in 75 of 870 proposals in one set, 1 in another and 0 in the remaining three; carboxylic acid in 51, 4, 1, 0 and 0. Every one of those ten counts is identical to the code Parent's count on the same objective, including in the sessions that diverged at evaluation 41, so the groups are being carried forward from the shared starting pool - the pool member COc1cc(F)cc(-c2ccc(C(CC(=O)O)NC(=O)C3CCCN3S(=O)(=O)c3cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c3)cc2)c1 contributes both - and are never rebuilt once lost.
transferable_gaps.gap: Ionisable and strongly polar functional groups are reachable only by inheritance from the starting molecules, never by construction.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The operator set needs explicit construction of acidic and basic groups (sulfonamide, sulfone, carboxylic acid, tetrazole, amidine) as attachable fragments, not only as atoms it may happen to retain. A generator whose polar vocabulary is fixed by its initial pool cannot reach any reward surface that needs a charge or a strong hydrogen-bond donor it did not start with.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 103 of 4,350 proposals have six or fewer heavy atoms and they arrive late, not early: ClCl at evaluation 262, C at 237, C#C at 166, BrBr at 293, CF at 283. Every one of them sits at or near its objective's floor - 0.0, ~1e-20, or exactly the 0.5 floor where an objective has one - so each is a wasted oracle call out of 300.
transferable_gaps.gap: Deletion is unbounded below, so sub-pharmacophore fragments are still being sent to the oracle in the last tenth of the budget.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The deletion and fragmentation operators need a lower heavy-atom bound, and a proposal that falls through it should be repaired or resampled rather than evaluated. The floor-scoring fragments carry no gradient information, so the budget spent on them is pure loss regardless of which objective is active.

transferable_gaps.evidence: The twelve highest-scoring molecules of one set are one Murcko scaffold with one atom changed - CCc1c(C)cc2c(cc(C(=O)N(Cl)c3ccccn3)n2F)c1OC and CCc1c(C)cc2c(cc(C(=O)N(Cl)c3ccccn3)n2Cl)c1OC are tied at 0.460926 - and that set's top 50 hold only 5 of the 177 scaffolds the run visited. Where the relabelling touches a ring atom nothing checks the result: CCCc1cc(C2=C3SN(CCN(C)CC2)C(=O)C(C)NC3=O)c2ccccc2n1 at 0.220375 puts an N-S bond inside a ring and CCCc1cc(C2=C3NN(CCN2C)C(=O)C(CC)CC3=O)c2ccccc2n1 at 0.223786 an N-N, and both score within 0.009 of their set's best.
transferable_gaps.gap: Late search is single-atom relabelling on one frozen skeleton, and the relabelling has no valence or ring-stability check.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Ring-atom substitution should draw from a table of heteroatom patterns that actually occur in stable rings, or should replace a whole ring rather than relabel one atom. Separately, the late budget needs a skeleton-level edit at a frequency comparable to the substituent edit; otherwise the last third of every session is spent enumerating one-atom neighbours of a single scaffold, which is where the flat landscapes stall.

transferable_gaps.evidence: This node differs from its code Parent only in the order of one random stream, and the whole physical envelope is invariant under that reshuffle: mean heavy atoms within 1.0, rings within 0.4, fsp3 within 0.01 and mean QED within 0.03 on all five objective sets, and two of fifteen sessions are identical for all 300 records. What is not invariant is the exploit motif. In one session the reshuffled path produced 183 O-halogen proposals against the Parent's 7 and finished at 0.472429 (CC1C(c2c3c(=O)n(OF)c(=O)n(C)c3cn2-c2cc(F)ccc2O)=CC1F) where the Parent kept an N-methyl imide and finished at 0.644370; in another it produced 190 N-halogen proposals against the Parent's 12. Where both paths found the same motif the outcome is exactly equal - one session pair ends at 0.620122 on both sides from a split at evaluation 171.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no frequency prior over functional groups, so which chemistry it converges on is decided by draw order rather than by its rules.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Ties between an ordinary functional group and a vanishingly rare one are currently broken by sampling order, which makes the generator's chemistry a property of its path. A proposal-time prior weighted by how often a group occurs in real compound collections - applied as a sampling weight, not as a score term - would make the chemistry a property of the rules and would remove the run-to-run variance this measurement exposes without touching any search law.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
